Hi @jonasatalter! Thank you so much for the support 🎉  
  
Totally get it, switching email is a big commitment. Good news is you can bring your history with you: Stitch.ai imports MBOX files, and your mail is then organized with Knots, Tags and Connections so related items are easy to find. Connecting your existing email accounts is also on our roadmap, along with a Teams workspace for collaboration coming very soon 👀  
  
And once you’re in, Stitchy (our AI assistant) can help write your emails and flag what matters.🐶  
  
Thanks again for the great questions, we really appreciate it! 🚀
